title: Abu Dhabi Talks End With Agreement in Principle on Large Prisoner Exchange, No Breakthrough
detail: The two-day US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended Nov 11 with an agreement in principle on a large prisoner-of-war exchange, but no breakthrough on a ceasefire, territory or security guarantees. Russia's Vladimir Medinsky confirmed the swap was agreed 'in principle'; Russian official Alexander Zorin said it could happen within two to three weeks. Europe was excluded from the direct talks. US envoys Jared Kushner and Witkoff planned to meet Putin in Moscow and then Zelenskyy in Dublin.
